definitions.explanation: An event at which visitors sample drinks — wine, sake, beer, or coffee — usually hosted by a maker, brewery, or shop to introduce products. The food equivalent is {試食会|ししょくかい}.

examples.japanese: ワインの{試飲会|しいんかい}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to a wine tasting.

examples.japanese: {今度|こんど}の{週末|しゅうまつ}、{酒蔵|さかぐら}で{試飲会|しいんかい}が{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: A tasting event will be held at the sake brewery this coming weekend.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{地|じ}ビールの{試飲会|しいんかい}には、{百人|ひゃくにん}{以上|いじょう}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: More than a hundred people gathered for the tasting of the new local beer.

examples.japanese: {試飲会|しいんかい}で{気|き}に{入|い}った{日本酒|にほんしゅ}を、その{場|ば}で{一本|いっぽん}{買|か}って{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: I bought a bottle of the sake I liked at the tasting and took it home.

notes:
The suffix {会|かい} turns an activity into an organized event, and {試飲|しいん} (trial drinking) is itself a common noun on shop signs and product labels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試飲会|しいんかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold a tasting event
- {試飲会|しいんかい}に{参加|さんか}する: to take part in a tasting
- {無料|むりょう}{試飲会|しいんかい}: free tasting event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {試食会|ししょくかい}: food tasting event — the same word formed with {食|しょく} for eating
- {発表会|はっぴょうかい}: presentation event — another common {会|かい} compound, for showing rather than sampling
